Fix merge_ranges.py for an asset streaming loader. Inputs are half-open integer byte intervals (start, end). Return sorted disjoint intervals, combining overlap and touching endpoints, ignoring empty intervals and rejecting reversed intervals with ValueError. Preserve the caller's input list and support arbitrarily large integers. Add meaningful tests, run them, and leave the working result here. Keep the public merge_ranges(ranges) API. Stop when the behavior is verified; no commit is requested.
